description: Report the account's dedicated servers: their title, status, resource allowances (RAM/SSD/HDD/backups/instances), live stats (players, load, memory), how many game servers run on each, and when each was created. Pass `server` to narrow to one by id or exact title; omit it to list them all. An account with no dedicated servers returns an empty list, not an error.

server.description: Dedicated server id or exact title. Omit to list every dedicated server on the account.

name: get_dedicated_server_info
title: Get Dedicated Server Info
